editions.title: Load Factor — 3 October
editions.lede: Three British touring companies published numbers this fortnight. Each one was really a statement about a year that has not happened yet.

items.headline: Saga publishes the number most operators keep to themselves
items.gist: H1 underlying pre-tax profit £46.6m (from £23.5m), revenue +14% to £366.3m, guidance raised to £65–70m; publishes a dated booked-load table

items.headline: The rivers ran dry in July. The bill arrives in 2027
items.gist: Saga river cruises 81% booked for the year at 27 Sep v 88% a year earlier, blamed on low European river levels

editions.title: Load Factor — 15 October
editions.lede: Every autumn the Civil Aviation Authority goes through the books of a thousand British holiday firms. Its figures this year account for 993 of the 1,042 licences that fell due.

items.headline: The annual check on who may hold your money
items.gist: CAA, 7 Oct: 1,624 ATOL holders; of 1,042 licences expiring 30 Sep, 951 renewed and 42 still in process, leaving 49 unaccounted for in the notice. About 20m ATOL-protected passengers Jan-Aug 2026, flat. Holder total barely moves: 1,607 (Oct 23), 1,616 (Apr 25), 1,624 now.

items.headline: Nine years in, KKR is selling Travelopia a piece at a time
items.gist: 14 Oct: Travelopia agreed to sell Experience Education (Travelbound, SkiBound, Edwin Doran, Masterclass, World Challenge, JCA; c.1,400 schools and c.100,000 pupils a year) to Rockaway Capital, price undisclosed, completion expected Q4 2026. KKR bought Travelopia from TUI for GBP 325m, completed June 2017: a nine-year-four-month hold. Earlier disposals: MyPlanet, Gullivers, and Sovereign/Citalia/American Holidays to TravCorp in July 2025. Core retained: Exodus Group, Quark, TCS World Travel, Le Boat, Sunsail, The Moorings, Enchanting Travels, Europe Express, Kalos Golf.

items.headline: Turnover up by nearly a third, and £1.5m of its own money at the end of it
items.gist: Newmarket Holidays Limited (02238316), year to 31 Dec 2024: turnover about £75.8m, up roughly £17.5m (+30%); cash £20.7m (+£4.4m); net assets £1.48m (+£1.43m). Soho Square Capital backed a minority buyout for existing shareholders in Oct 2024; founders stay majority. A 2025 set of accounts was filed 14 July 2026 but the document could not be retrieved this edition.

items.headline: Confidence slipped, and more holidaymakers went to a human being
items.gist: ABTA consumer research at the Madeira convention, 13 Oct: travel confidence index 50, down 3 but second-highest on record; 88% took a holiday Aug 25-Jul 26; 38% booked via agent or operator, up from 34%, with 18-24s up 6pt to 35%; ease of booking 60% (from 56%), value for money 44% (+5); 15% intend to spend less, 52% of those blaming cost of living; 63% of overseas travellers booked a package (+2).

watch.text: 6 April 2027: the Package Travel and Linked Travel Arrangements (Amendment) Regulations 2026 come into force. LTAs fold into the package definition, suppliers must refund organisers within 14 days, and agent-only declarations stop working. Contracts signed before that date keep the old rules.
